title: Speech team config
description: Schema for speech.yaml in a repository's convention home (default docs/conventions): the team layer of the speech plugin's settings. Keys are read by the install-python-deps SessionStart hook and listed in plugins/speech/README.md, Configuration. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

install_python_deps_enabled.description: Whether the SessionStart install-python-deps hook installs speech Python packages (numpy, onnxruntime) into the plugin data directory. A user-layer value in pluginConfigs wins when set; otherwise this repository value overrides the plugin default (false).
